text: 5: The idea—This animal has the figure and gracefulness of the horse, claimed to the firstness of the flag. He is about 7 feet long, from the point of the muzzle to the origin of the tall, and about, feet high. The colon of his him is beautiful and uniform, con- filing of alternate parallel rings of black and white dipuled in the melt regular manner, as reprefeden in the place, lEXXY, fig.3]. He is generally left than the horse, and larger than the afsl.
